claims.assertion: Yazhi alleges record numbers of regressive entities entered through portals and took positions, manipulating hospital staff; she calls their harvest human and animal suffering and souls, especially in the UK.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: She says suffering is consensual only from higher planes; for incarnate humans it is an atrocity, while entities seek to return souls to harsher lives.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Awakened souls can reject Matrix entities or escape through high frequency; unprepared souls risk nightmare-like low astral states, and she warns against dying now.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
